shortBio.en: The Doors vocalist; baritone croon and spoken sections over Manzarek organ.
shortBio.zh: The Doors 主唱；在 Manzarek 风琴上的男中音 croon 与说白段落。

body.en:
Born 1943. Fronts The Doors 1965–71. Leather pants, poetry notebooks, blues-psych delivery. Dies 1971 in Paris.

Seat is voice+lyric; band has no bassist onstage—organ covers low end.
body.zh:
1943 年生。1965–71 主唱 The Doors。皮裤、诗本、蓝调迷幻咬字。1971 于巴黎去世。

席位是人声+词；乐队台上无贝斯——风琴补低频。
